svg.title: Blue tiles: four independent inputs and sixteen copied outputs
svg.text: Blue tiles: input, output, and why there are six
One Life cell = one bit. Four repeated corner keys carry the SAME bit; they are not four independent states.
A, B, C, D: four different cells
Each quadrant has all four values
connector layout, not a larger body.
Six blue types: both faces rotate together
Source: six 4x4 blue types and neighbourhood copying. Sparse bottom keys are a proposed geometric realization.
Plan views use the SAME global coordinates for both faces; do not mirror the bottom labels as if viewing from below.
